'''Justin Crook''' (also published as '''Justin Cook''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2001 Anniston tournament]] on 23 November 2001 with [[No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Watto fakeout]], according to Steven Tubbs's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3116">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-23-annistion-alabama-11-23-2001d3116/ annistion-alabama-11-23-2001], DeckTech (Niado "Niado Deugad" Deugad, 23 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-23-annistion-alabama-11-23-2001d3116/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He played at [[2001 Atlanta DPC]] on 28 July 2001 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit (complete with illegal start)]], according to Devon Clark's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2752">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-31-atlanta-dpc-7-28-01d2752/ atlanta-dpc-7-28-01], DeckTech (Devon "Devonator" Clark, 31 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-31-atlanta-dpc-7-28-01d2752/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
